game.title: Pittu Garam (Seven Stones)
game.description: Popular street game where players knock down a pile of seven stones with a ball, then try to rebuild while avoiding being hit by opponents.
howToPlay: Step 1: Stack seven flat stones in a pile.
Step 2: One team throws the ball to knock down the stone pile.
Step 3: The throwing team tries to rebuild the pile while opponents throw the ball to hit them.
Step 4: If hit by the ball, that player is out.
Step 5: The rebuilding team must avoid being hit while stacking stones.
Step 6: If the pile is successfully rebuilt, the team scores points.
Step 8: The game requires speed, accuracy, and teamwork.
Step 9: Players can catch the ball to eliminate throwers.
Step 10: Multiple rounds determine the winner.
